description: Java class 'ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment' extending Fragment, managing directory access and display within an Android app, including UI setup, handling directory selection, and updating directory contents.

classes.name: ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment for browsing and accessing directories with scoped storage, managing UI components, directory entries, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes activity context and storage manager.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from directory access intent, persists URI permissions, updates directory entries.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, button click handlers, RecyclerView, and directory spinner.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current directory state and entries.

methods.name: updateDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Queries and updates the list of directory entries based on selected URI.

methods.name: getDirectoryName
methods.description: Maps user-friendly directory names to environment directory constants.
